text:
kevin: Heads-up: we've got duplicated invoices in NetSuite tied to a webhook retry window. Not a revenue leak but nasty attribution noise.

samir: when did this start?

kevin: first seen 2024-10-05 03:00 UTC after a Stripe webhook spike. Pattern: same stripe invoice id appears twice in NetSuite as two separate records (ns_internal_id different).

mira: does our connector use Stripe's idempotency or external_id to dedupe?

ana: Connector should set externalId = stripe.invoice.id on create and use it to dedupe by search. But logs show externalId missing on some create calls.

kevin: here's snippet from webhook-bridge logs around the spike: 
```
2024-10-05T03:01:12Z INFO received webhook evt=invoice.finalized id=evt_3Lx... headers={idempotency-key=abc123, content-length=12023}
2024-10-05T03:01:12Z WARN forwarding to ns-connector dropped headers: [idempotency-key]
2024-10-05T03:01:13Z INFO ns-connector createInvoice payload={"total":120000,"lines":..., "externalId": null}
2024-10-05T03:01:13Z INFO ns-connector created ns_id=NET-98765
2024-10-05T03:01:20Z INFO retrying webhook evt=evt_3Lx... attempt=2
2024-10-05T03:01:20Z INFO ns-connector createInvoice payload={"total":120000,"lines":..., "externalId": "inv_44X"}
2024-10-05T03:01:20Z INFO ns-connector created ns_id=NET-98766
```
In the first create the externalId is null (dropped header = missing idempotency context), second create has the stripe invoice id. NetSuite ends up with two records.

samir: so the bridge is stripping the idempotency-key header which downstream code relied on to populate externalId. Why would that happen only during the spike?

mira: hypothesis: when content-length > 10k we route via chunked proxy that normalizes headers and drops non-standard ones. That proxy was rolled out last month in front of webhook-bridge.

ana: billing-bot reported webhook-bridge errors around the same time: "webhook-bridge proxy chunked mode enabled, removed 3 non-whitelisted headers".

billing-bot: Alert: webhook-bridge chunked-proxy trimmed headers 2024-10-05T03:00:59Z - removed: idempotency-key, x-request-id, x-stripe-signature.

kevin: Impact: duplicates observed for ~9 Stripe invoices in the 3:00-03:10 window. Finance reconciliation flagged ~7 misattributions. No revenue lost but customer-facing invoice numbers may be confusing.

samir: Proposed fix: 1) whitelist idempotency-key and x-stripe-signature in chunked proxy config 2) add defensive code in ns-connector to look for stripe.invoice.id in payload body if header missing 3) backfill/remove duplicate NetSuite records (safest: mark duplicates and merge).

mira: For backfill, SQL to find likely duplicates in analytics: 
```
SELECT stripe_invoice_id, COUNT(*) as cnt, ARRAY_AGG(netsuite_id) as ns_ids
FROM analytics.netsuite_invoices
WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY stripe_invoice_id
HAVING cnt > 1;
```
Then cross-check amounts and dates and merge records where externalId differs but stripe_invoice_id same.

kevin: I'll patch the proxy config first (whitelist headers) and ship an emergency release to webhook-bridge. ETA 2 hours. Samir, can you add the defensive lookup in ns-connector?

samir: yes, I'll add: if payload.externalId is null AND body.invoice && body.invoice.id then set externalId = body.invoice.id before create. Also add a unit test for header-missing flows.

ana: create FIN-BILL-330, priority P2. We should also notify affected customers whose portal shows two invoices. Mira, can you produce a list?

mira: running the query now. Draft outreach: "We detected duplicate billing entries in your dashboard caused by a temporary sync issue. No change to charges; we've merged duplicates and updated your invoice view."

kevin: sandbox rollback plan: revert proxy header whitelist if anything breaks. But this should be safe.

billing-bot: Deploy webhook-bridge release succeeded 2024-10-05T04:12:05Z - headers preserved.

samir: ns-connector patch merged and deployed to prod with unit tests. Also added a reconciliation job that flags duplicates daily for 30 days.

kevin: Reprocess script completed in sandbox: merged 9 duplicate pairs, produced audit CSV for finance. No net delta in revenue.

mira: Outreach list ready, will send after FIN signs off on copies.

ana: Thanks team. Action items: Kevin (proxy config + deploy), Samir (defensive code + tests), Mira (reconciles & outreach), Kevin/Samir (run merge script and audit), Ana (owner of FIN-BILL-330). We'll write a short postmortem after stabilization. :shrug:
